Bug_Title: "Collection.toArray()" should be passed an array of the proper type
Bug_Explanation: The Collection.toArray() method is called without passing an argument which results in it returning an Object[] array. This returned array is then cast to a String[] array which will throw a ClassCastException at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the getStringArray() method is called with a list that contains a null value. This causes a ClassCastException because the toArray() method returns an Object[] array which cannot be cast to a String[] array.
